name: zinterp_context_echo_tokens
description: zInterp_Context::EchoTokens prints each current interpreter token followed by a space and then prints a trailing newline.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted for this isolated interpreter diagnostic helper; tier S work is deferred to a coherent zInterp source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and decompilation for 0x4c1870 validate loading tokenCount at context offset 0x08, iterating tokenList entries at offset 0x20, printing each token through printf("%s "), then printing a trailing newline and returning that printf result.
Native smoke zinterp_context_echo_tokens_smoke captures stdout and verifies the printed token text and newline return value.
